title: athyrium thelypteroides f. acrostichoides
intro: Athyrium thelypteroides f. acrostichoides, commonly known as Lady Fern or American Lady Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Athyrium genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in Lady Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
